prompt: Let's compare 2/6 and 5/6 together, one step at a time.

steps.title: Step 1: Check the denominators
steps.body: Both fractions have the same denominator, **6**. That means both wholes are cut into six equal parts — so the pieces are the same size.
steps.why: Comparing only works when the pieces are the same size.

steps.title: Step 2: Compare the numerators
steps.body: Now look at the numerators: 2 and 5. Since every piece is the same size, having **5 pieces** is more than having **2 pieces**.

steps.title: Step 3: Write the comparison
steps.body: So 5/6 is greater than 2/6, and we write it as **5/6 > 2/6**. Same-size pieces, more of them — that's the whole comparison.
steps.why: The symbol always opens toward the bigger amount.
